name: proto-default-roots-option-names-no-extension
description: With no buf.yaml and no proto.import_paths, the import roots are buf's for a directory with no buf.yaml, the target root, besides the include roots of upstream copies: every import resolves, so an option naming an extension no scope resolves is protoc's error and the file publishes nothing, a schema-unparsed note naming it. Since a schema file that could not be read may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
